items.source_en:
An unfortunate update: Captain Rainn of the Olivian just backed out of our existing supply agreement. We "can't pay enough to make it worth the risk." That makes the second smuggling contract lost in six months. If this is not rectified, other captains may follow suit when realize we cannot afford to retaliate for this behavior.

Rainn was our best Akila produce supplier. How can we do without those shipments? How can we possibly expect the Council, let alone the Speaker, to tell the public they must rely even more on seaweed rations?

A replacement supplier must be secured quickly, or we are headed towards a breaking point. I just know it.
items.legacy_ko:

레인은 우리의 가장 좋은 아킬라 농산물 공급자였다. 그 물자 없이 우리가 어떻게 살 수 있겠는가? 대의회는 물론이고, 어떻게 대변자 님께서 신민들에게 해조류 배급에 더 의존해야 한다고 말할 수 있겠는가?

items.source_en:
Great Serpent,

Some level of success today. I was able to connect to an old directory and discovered this was once a military base with a focus on grav drive advancement. Now I understand why Mihael believes I have "all I need" to recreate Anasko's work. 

Mihael must have learned I was part of the Speaker's original team, recruited to assist him to help reach You. I wonder where he may have gotten such information. My dear Envoy cousins perhaps? But those thoughts are a distraction I don't need right now.
items.legacy_ko:
위대한 뱀이시여,

오늘 꽤 진전을 이루어냈습니다. 오래된 디렉토리에 접속하는 데 성공해 한때 이곳은 중력 구동기의 발전을 목표로 하던 군사 기지였음을 알아냈습니다. 이제서야 왜 미해일이 아나스코의 결과물을 재현하는 데 '필요한 모든 것'을 구했다고 한 것인지 알겠습니다.

I am writing to express my concern over the bruising I frequently see while examining both of your sons, though especially Amila. I have spoken with the schoolmaster and they do not corroborate your explanation that Amila has been getting into fights at school.

Eibari Irara

items.source_en:
As expected, I didn't sleep well last night. At least this morning I can turn to my camp and think of what to do next. 

Planning ahead certainly paid off. I've been slowly building up this area ever since Tane and I first discussed plans to get me off of Korriban. I figured I'd need a safe place if I had to leave unexpectedly and lay low. 

I have the tracking device he gave me, so I can only hope he puts two and two together. In the meantime, I'm hoping to distract my mind by organizing my new temporary home here. Who knows how long it might be before Tane finds me.
items.legacy_ko:
예상대로 어젯밤에 잠을 제대로 못 잤다. 적어도 오늘 아침에는 캠프로 돌아가서 다음에 해야 할 일을 생각해 볼 수 있을 거 같다.

미리 계획한 것이 확실히 효과가 있었다. 테인과 처음 코리반에서 탈출할 계획을 논의한 이후로 이 장소를 천천히 세웠다. 갑작스럽게 떠나서 숨어 지내야 한다면 안전한 장소가 필요할 거라 생각했다.

테인이 준 추적 장치를 가지고 있으니, 테인이 정황을 보고 추측할 수 있었으면 좋겠다. 그동안 나는 이곳에서 새 임시 거처를 정리하며 마음을 추스를 수 있었으면 좋겠다. 테인이 나를 찾을 때까지 얼마나 걸릴지 모르니까.

To Our Valuable Team,

Due to factors outside of our control it is no longer economically viable for us to continue producing Orm Spring Water. The costs incurred with running this remote facility and delivering to the city has become too much for the business to handle. We greatly appreciate your service. Please vacate the facility with the last delivery.
